description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the Investing.com high price (“H”) for any EUR/USD hourly candle for an hour on or before the listed end date (ET) is equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Data for a given candle will be considered finalized once the next candle appears on the specified graph. The last trading day of a given week will be considered finalized once the market closes on that day, typically at 5 PM ET on Friday.

This market’s resolution will be based solely on information from the “H” figure located at the top of the EUR/USD Streaming Chart on Investing.com for the specified currency pair (e.g., https://www.investing.com/currencies/eur-usd-chart).

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders are pricing EUR/USD around 1.159 amid a narrowing Fed-ECB policy gap, with the pair up roughly 1.5% over the past month as the dollar softens. Recent ECB rate hikes to 2.25% and projections for 3.0% 2026 inflation contrast with the Fed's apparent pause or modest easing path under new leadership, supporting euro resilience despite modest euro-area growth. Key near-term drivers include upcoming FOMC communications, ECB Governing Council meetings, U.S. and eurozone CPI releases, and any shifts in Treasury yields or risk sentiment that could alter rate differentials. Historical ranges this year have spanned 1.13–1.20, leaving room for volatility around major data prints.
